structured_case_analysis.pre_notice_evidence_trap_tip: Check if the document has a 16-digit alphanumeric 'CNR Number' verifiable on ecourts.gov.in. If it does NOT have a CNR number, it is NOT a court summons or warrant—it is either a private lawyer's notice or a recovery agent bluff!
structured_case_analysis.plain_language_standing_en: Effective July 1, 2024, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 replaced the old IPC (Cheating is now Section 318 BNS; Criminal Breach of Trust is Section 316 BNS; Criminal Intimidation is Section 351 BNS). Under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, if this involves a real court proceeding or criminal threat, you can get a free government advocate via NALSA (Helpline 15100).

notice_and_clause_trap_decoder.summary_assessment: Contains unenforceable intimidation bluffs / void clauses under Indian law.

decoded_flags.clause_or_threat_type: Fake Recovery / Advocate 'Arrest Warrant, Passport Seizure & Bank Freeze' Bluff
decoded_flags.statutory_reality: Private advocates, landlords, and recovery agents CANNOT issue arrest warrants, freeze bank accounts, or seize passports. Civil debt recovery is not an arrest offense, Lok Adalats NEVER issue warrants, and genuine court summons always carry a 16-digit CNR number verifiable on ecourts.gov.in.
decoded_flags.recommended_counter_move: Do not panic or pay under threat. Screenshot the message, verify absence of a 16-digit CNR number on ecourts.gov.in, and report criminal intimidation under BNS Section 351 and RBI Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in).

**WITHOUT PREJUDICE**

**From:** Aarav Verma (Test Claimant), residing at Flat 402, Indiranagar, Bengaluru - 560038

**SUBJECT: FINAL PRE-LITIGATION LEGAL NOTICE FOR RECOVERY OF ₹35,000 AND STATUTORY COMPLIANCE (INTIMIDATING LEGAL NOTICES, CRIMINAL THREATS & RED-LINE TRIAGE)**

Sir / Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of my self-represented claim, I hereby serve upon you the following categorical Legal Demand Notice:

### 1. CHRONOLOGICAL STATEMENT OF FACTS
1. Received intimidating legal communication or criminal threat. (*Requires verification of whether it is a private lawyer's pre-litigation notice or a real Court Summons (CNR check).*)

Your continued failure and refusal to discharge the lawful liability of **₹35,000** is in direct breach of the following statutory provisions:
- **Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 (Section 316 (Criminal Breach of Trust), Section 318 (Cheating) & Section 351 (Criminal Intimidation)):** Effective July 1, 2024, BNS 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code (IPC 1860). ### 3. FINAL DEMAND & CONSEQUENCE OF NON-COMPLIANCE

A copy of this Notice is retained in my records for production before the competent Court/Authority as Annexures.

Yours faithfully,

**Aarav Verma (Test Claimant)**
